["EO 12549 contains dated one-time tasks: section 3 (agency regulations proposed within four months and published within twelve months of the OMB guidelines), section 5 (first report within two years), section 7 (OMB report to the President within three years). A report date is a deadline, not an end, and no held source shows that these were performed; the dossier's 29 'suspension' later-event candidates (dated 2020 onward, scope not stated) were not read as acting on the order and no held source ties them to it. Missing: the OMB guidelines issued under section 6 and the agency regulations they required, and EO 12689 (held only as an APP mirror and an FR text not attached as an acting text) read clause by clause against sections 1-3 and 5-7, with a CURRENT record for 2 CFR part 180 (authority citation naming the order) to establish the current predicate."]
